item.title: African Pack
item.description: This pack was created by me and my friend Fireplume, and it has a bonus download in it that I just made for it. [African Clawless Otter] I haven’t gotten a pic for it yet btw, but it’s pretty great so it’s a surprise how the exhibit should look like.

item.title: Honey Badger
item.description: Add the angriest animal in existence (allegedly) to your zoo.

item.title: Ratel
item.description: The Ratel, also known as the Honey Badger, is a fearless African mammal renowned for its incredible courage and entered into the Guinness Book of Records for its fearlessness.

item.title: Wolverine
item.description: The Wolverine is a fierce and powerful predator found in the forests and tundras of the Northern Hemisphere.
